meta.promptText: India mein oily skin ke liye 500 rupees ke andar konsa face wash kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
Oily skin ke liye **₹500 ke andar sabse balanced choice: Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA Face Wash (100 ml)**—price lagbhag ₹299, fragrance-free, aur excess oil/blackheads ke liye useful hai.[2][6]

- **Acne, blackheads ya clogged pores:** Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA — ~₹278–299.[2]
- **Sensitive oily skin:** Simple Kind To Skin Refreshing Face Wash — ~₹224–450; gentle daily cleansing ke liye.[1][7]
- **Bahut budget-friendly daily use:** Himalaya Purifying Neem Face Wash — ~₹120–250.[1][5]
- **Mild oily skin, acne nahi:** Minimalist Gentle Gel Face Wash — soap/sulfate-free option.[8]
- **Alternative acne option:** The Derma Co 2% Salicylic Acid Face Wash — ~₹263–299.[2]

**Kaise use karein:** Salicylic-acid face wash se shuru mein raat ko ek baar use karein; dryness ya irritation ho to alternate days kar dein. Din mein maximum do baar wash karein, phir lightweight, non-comedogenic moisturiser aur sunscreen lagayein.[2]

**Final recommendation:** Agar acne/blackheads hain to **Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA**; sirf oily skin hai aur sensitivity bhi hai to **Simple Refreshing Face Wash**. Prices seller aur offers ke hisaab se badal sakti hain.
